description: This file contains unit tests for the PermissionManager component, verifying permission status queries and ensuring permissions for various capabilities such as voice wake, location, microphone, speech recognition, and screen recording.

classes.name: PermissionManagerTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for verifying the behavior of PermissionManager permission handling functionalities.

methods.name: `voice wake permission helpers match status`
methods.description: Tests whether the current voice wake permissions match the ensured permissions without interaction.

methods.name: `status can query non interactive caps`
methods.description: Verifies that querying the status of a set of capabilities returns the expected number of entries.

methods.name: `ensure non interactive does not throw`
methods.description: Checks that ensuring permissions for capabilities in a non-interactive manner completes without errors.

methods.name: `location status matches authorization always`
methods.description: Ensures that the permission status for location matches the CLLocationManager's authorization status.

methods.name: `ensure location non interactive matches authorization always`
methods.description: Verifies that the non-interactive permission ensuring process for location matches CLLocationManager's authorization status.
